notes:
v0.3.33 - local model settings, and the shortcuts that did nothing

NEW: a "Local models" screen (/models in the sidebar, below /memory). Per
model it shows what each context window actually costs in memory on THIS PC -
weights plus conversation cache, summed - and colours each size by whether it
fits your graphics card, spills into system RAM, or will not load. It
recommends a size from your real RAM and VRAM, and shows nothing at all if it
could not read them rather than guessing. Reasoning and keep-alive are
switchable per model too. Installing and uninstalling models moved here from
Settin
